Theme

Latin word

tempus

tempus, temporis n.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a critical time, the circumstances; the moment, the time (for something); the time, the occasion; time; in the plural, the times, a period; a tense of the verb; time: the time that passes, and the time for something
